meta.name: Pluto TV Pixel World
meta.description:
Pluto TV Pixel World brings you giant blocks of all things Minecraft! Explore some of the wildest mods ever built and tag along with top gamers like Thinknoodles and PrestonPlayz. Don’t miss the excitement on Pluto TV Pixel World!

Shows: TBNR Presents, I Sent Baby Preston to the 4 Most Extreme Minecraft Schools: Part 3, New Baby Stormcutter Dragon Goes to Dragon Daycare!, TBNR Presents: 1 Elimination = 4,000 V-Bucks with My Little Brother! / One Henchmen Chest Challenge with My Little Brother!, Ropos First Dragons Adventure!
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
